#values carry through all the years for a given stop, but missing values vary by year
pctMiss=0.25
#note which covars are missing values
miss_cov = c(1,ncov);miss_cov # vector[n] with indexes of covariates missing >=1 value, corresponding to relevant covs[] columns
#now generate covariate values
#generate all covar values (nstops * ncov) and put in matrix
covsVals=rnorm(nstops * ncov * 1, 0, 0.1);covsVals[abs(covsVals)>0.999]=0
covsMat=matrix(covsVals,ncol=ncov);head(covsMat);dim(covsMat);hist(covsMat)
#bind in an array with depth = nyrs
covsFull=covsMat
for (i in 2:nyrs) {covsFull=abind(covsFull,covsMat,along=3)};head(covsFull);dim(covsFull)
#randomly make some missing
covs=covsFull
for (i in 1:nyrs) {
  for (j in miss_cov) {
  covs[sample(1:nrow(covs),size=ceiling(nrow(covs)*pctMiss)),j,i]=NA
  }
};head(covs)

#simulated responses to covariates
sp_resp=matrix(0,nrow=nspec,ncol=ncov);sp_resp
plot((-5):5, invlogit((-5):5))
hist(rowSums(covsFull[,,1]*10))
diag(sp_resp)=10;diag(sp_resp)=diag(sp_resp)*c(1,-1);sp_resp
sp_resp[ncol(sp_resp)+1,c(1,3)]=c(-10,10)
sp_resp[ncol(sp_resp)+2,1:2]=c(10,-10);sp_resp
#random sample pres/abs
y=array(NA,dim=c(nstops,nspec,nyrs));dim(y)  #array[st,sp,yr] all pres/abs values with NAs for missing surveys and out of range species

for (i in 1:nspec) {
  for (j in 1:nyrs) {
    y[,i,j]=apply(matrix(invlogit(rowSums(t(t(covsFull[,,j])*sp_resp[i,]))),ncol=1),1,FUN=rbern,n=1)
  }
};head(y)

#only keep in-range records for a species; others should be NA
head(sp_stops)
for (i in 1:nspec) {
  for (j in 1:nyrs) {
  y[,i,j][(1:nstops)[-sort(sp_stops[,i])]]=NA  
  }
};y[,,1]
y[,,2]

#only keep species records from surveys that exist
for (i in 1:nrow(y)) {
  for (j in 1:(dim(y)[3])) {
    if (length(which(yrs_stops[,i]==j))==0) {
      y[i,,j]=NA
    }
  }
};head(y);yrs_stops[,1:5]


#MORE CONSTANTS
yrs_miss_cov_stops=array(NA,dim=c(nyrs,nstops,length(miss_cov)));yrs_miss_cov_stops
for (i in 1:ncol(yrs_miss_cov_stops)) {
  for (j in 1:(dim(yrs_miss_cov_stops)[3])) {
  m=which(is.na(covs[i,miss_cov[j],])==TRUE)
  if (length(m)!=0) {
  yrs_miss_cov_stops[1:length(m),i,j]=m  
  }
 }
};yrs_miss_cov_stops

yrs_miss_cov_stops[,1:25,1]
yrs_stops[,1:25]

#now get rid of stop_years that don't exist
for (i in 1:ncol(yrs_miss_cov_stops)) {
  for (j in 1:(dim(yrs_miss_cov_stops)[3])) {
    if (length(sort(match(sort(yrs_miss_cov_stops[,i,j]),yrs_stops[,i])))==0) {
      yrs_miss_cov_stops[,i,j]=NA
    } else { l=length(sort(match(sort(yrs_miss_cov_stops[,i,j]),yrs_stops[,i])))
    yrs_miss_cov_stops[1:l,i,j] = yrs_stops[,i][sort(match(sort(yrs_miss_cov_stops[,i,j]),yrs_stops[,i]))]
    if (l<nyrs) {
      yrs_miss_cov_stops[(l+1):nyrs,i,j] = NA
    }
    }  
  }
}

yrs_miss_cov_stops[,1:25,1]
yrs_stops[,1:25]

yrs_stops
yrs_miss_cov_stops

#then make NEW df of number of years missing each covariates by stop
#nyrs_miss_cov_stops[st,miss_cov]
nyrs_miss_cov_stops=matrix(NA,nrow=nstops,ncol=length(miss_cov))
for (i in 1:nrow(nyrs_miss_cov_stops)) {
  for (j in 1:ncol(nyrs_miss_cov_stops)) {
    nyrs_miss_cov_stops[i,j]=length(sort(yrs_miss_cov_stops[,i,j]))
  }
};nyrs_miss_cov_stops

#then make NEW df of stops missing any years by covariate
#and make NEW vector of number of stops missing any year by covariate
#stops_miss_any_year[st,miss_cov]
#nstops_miss_any_year[miss_cov]

stops_miss_any_year=matrix(NA,nrow=nstops,ncol=length(miss_cov))
nstops_miss_any_year=NA
for (j in 1:ncol(stops_miss_any_year)) {
  stops_loop=sort(which(nyrs_miss_cov_stops[,j]>0))
  stops_miss_any_year[1:length(stops_loop),j]=stops_loop
  nstops_miss_any_year[j]=length(stops_loop)
};stops_miss_any_year=stops_miss_any_year[1:(max(nstops_miss_any_year)+1),]

stops_miss_any_year;nstops_miss_any_year

#then set up the priors for the covars:
cov_priors = array(NA,dim=c(nstops,length(miss_cov),length(unique((s.yrs))),2));head(cov_priors);dim(cov_priors) #array[st,miss_cov,s.yrs,parameters] #for missing covariate prior distribution parameters (shape1 and shape2)

#use a truncated normal distribution to simulate values from true covariate, then use a beta distribution to approximate it

for (cov in 1:length(miss_cov)) {
  for (st in stops_miss_any_year[1:(nstops_miss_any_year[cov]),cov]) {
    for (yr in yrs_miss_cov_stops[1:nyrs_miss_cov_stops[st,cov],st,cov]) {
      v=rtruncnorm(500, a=0.0001, b=0.9999, mean = covsFull[st,cov,yr], sd = runif(1, 0.03, 0.3))
      p=ebeta(v)$parameters
      cov_priors[st,cov,s.yrs[yr],] = c(p[1],p[2])
    #  print(c(cov,st,yr))
    } #years
  } #stops
};cov_priors[1:15,,,] #covariates

#now get indexing array/df for relevant super-years for cov_priors
# Syrs_miss_cov_stops = array[1:max(s.yrs),nstops,miss_cov] with each sorted column showing which super-years were missing each covariate
# nSyrs_miss_cov_stops = df[st,miss_cov] with each column showing the number of years missing a given covariate (cols) for a given stop (rows)

#make new empty objects to hold values
Syrs_miss_cov_stops=yrs_miss_cov_stops
Syrs_miss_cov_stops[is.na(Syrs_miss_cov_stops)==FALSE]=NA;Syrs_miss_cov_stops

nSyrs_miss_cov_stops=nyrs_miss_cov_stops
nSyrs_miss_cov_stops[is.na(nSyrs_miss_cov_stops)==FALSE]=NA;nSyrs_miss_cov_stops

for (i in 1:nstops) {
  for (j in 1:length(miss_cov)) {
    l=length(sort(yrs_miss_cov_stops[,i,j]))
    if (l>0) {
      v=unique(s.yrs[sort(yrs_miss_cov_stops[,i,j])])
      Syrs_miss_cov_stops[1:length(v),i,j]=v
    }
    nSyrs_miss_cov_stops[i,j]=length(v)
  }
}

Syrs_miss_cov_stops
Syrs_miss_cov_stops=Syrs_miss_cov_stops[1:(max(nSyrs_miss_cov_stops)+1),,];Syrs_miss_cov_stops

nSyrs_miss_cov_stops
